PMC4032947.screening_reason: Rat study of psilocin effects on spatial memory acquisition, retrieval and consolidation.

anchors.quote: The group treated with the low dose of psilocin (1 mg/kg) showed significant impairment in solving the Carousel maze task in sessions 3 and 4

There was no significant difference between the control group and the group treated with 1 mg/kg of psilocin ( P > 0.05) during all five sessions
